questions.question: In 2022, how many total licensed drivers of all ages were recorded in California?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_drivers_licenses_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='TOTAL', header=None)
# Locate header row with STATE
header_idx = df[df.iloc[:, 0] == 'STATE'].index[0]
state_col = 0
total_col = df.iloc[header_idx].tolist().index('TOTAL')

# Find California row
ca_row = df[df.iloc[:, state_col].astype(str).str.startswith('California')].index[0]
result = int(df.iloc[ca_row, total_col])

questions.question: Which three states had the highest number of total licensed drivers in 2022?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_drivers_licenses_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='TOTAL', header=None)
header_idx = df[df.iloc[:, 0] == 'STATE'].index[0]
total_col = df.iloc[header_idx].tolist().index('TOTAL')

data = df.iloc[header_idx + 1 : 65].copy()  # rows 15 to 65 (0-indexed 14 to 64)
data = data[~data.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.lower().str.startswith('total')]

data['state_clean'] = data.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.replace(r'\s*\(\d+\)', '', regex=True).str.strip()
data['total_drivers'] = pd.to_numeric(data.iloc[:, total_col])
top3 = data.sort_values(by='total_drivers', ascending=False).head(3)
result = top3['state_clean'].tolist()

questions.question: Did Texas have more licensed female drivers than male drivers in 2022?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df_f = pd.read_excel('fhwa_drivers_licenses_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='FEMALES', header=None)
df_m = pd.read_excel('fhwa_drivers_licenses_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='MALES', header=None)

row_f = df_f[df_f.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.startswith('Texas')].index[0]
row_m = df_m[df_m.iloc[:, 0].astype(str).str.startswith('Texas')].index[0]

total_f = float(df_f.iloc[row_f, 16])
total_m = float(df_m.iloc[row_m, 16])

result = 'yes' if total_f > total_m else 'no'

questions.question: How many states reported any licensed drivers under age 16 in 2022?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('fhwa_drivers_licenses_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='TOTAL', header=None)
# Column T is index 19 (<16)
# State rows are rows 15 to 65 (index 14 to 64)
states_df = df.iloc[14:65].copy()
under_16 = pd.to_numeric(states_df.iloc[:, 19], errors='coerce').fillna(0)
result = int((under_16 > 0).sum())

questions.question: What was the difference between the number of female and male licensed drivers aged 85 and over across the nation in 2022?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df_f = pd.read_excel('fhwa_drivers_licenses_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='FEMALES', header=None)
df_m = pd.read_excel('fhwa_drivers_licenses_2022.xlsx', sheet_name='MALES', header=None)

# Total row is row 66 (index 65), column P (index 15) is 85 AND OVER
female_85_over = float(df_f.iloc[65, 15])
male_85_over = float(df_m.iloc[65, 15])

result = round(abs(female_85_over - male_85_over), 3)
